message: Fair trout conditions right now. Could go either way.
positive_factors: Slightly rising pressure — neutral to mild
Overcast skies have a favorable impact on biting activity

tactics.species_reason: cool water ~49°F favors trout; bass sluggish
tactics.where: Shoreline & shallow cover — favor the windward shore
tactics.where_reason: fish push shallow toward the bank in low light / cool water; wind stacks plankton and baitfish on the wind-blown bank
tactics.method_reason: wind makes fly casting tough and rewards covering water

fly_options.name: Woolly Buggers / leeches (slow strip)
fly_options.why: all-purpose in low light, wind, or stained water — both species

fly_options.name: Streamers (sculpin / baitfish)
fly_options.why: active fish chasing bait; strip on a sink-tip

spin_options.name: Spinners / spinnerbaits
spin_options.why: chop or cloud cover — cover water at mid-depth

tactics.season_note: Fall: both species feed up on baitfish — bigger streamers/swimbaits shine.
tactics.summary: Rainbow trout · Shoreline & shallow cover · Shallow — top ~0–8 ft · lean spin fishing
